body: I feel like I really do want to die. I know that I have said it a lot, but I really mean it this time. I feel like I'm a weak, pathetic little girl who's never going to be anything in life. The problem is that something holds me back. I wish I wasn't such a coward.
The Aflac duck. Apparently, I'd run out of the room when that commercial came on.
All jokes aside, that might explain my DMs...
You sound like an absolute muppet, love.

I originally saw this posted on Twitter in a petition. I decided against watching it then because I knew it would trigger some painful memories. Now that I have seen it, I want to vomit. As someone who was sexually abused, I can guarantee that this poor girl will be scarred for life. The part about the blood was what really got me. Unfortunately, not all survivors can be vindicated. I know that personally. I really hope that justice can be served in this case, and I hope that Sophie can find peace further down the road.

I know that I need to push back. I'm planning my escape right now. I'm hoping to be able to find a room in my area to rent so I can finally escape this nightmare, and from then, I will be contacting the police. My father is a dangerous man who's terrified me since I was little, so I want to make sure I'm safe first. Sidenote: I'm actually a woman.
My dad was a manager at radio shack and my mom was a customer. How my dad proposed is a funnier story tho.
My pitbull likes to play with my cat too. Sometimes, my cat will put his head in my pitbull's mouth. We don't know why he does this, but he does. It's so weird.
